description: A large procession of peasants, women and clergy in worn Tudor-era clothing and hoods walks along a muddy path under a stormy sky. A man carries a maroon banner showing a gold chalice, a red heart, stylised pale hands and feet with small red marks, and the letters IHC. A Gothic church with a square tower stands on a hill behind, with bare trees. The painting fills the image with no frame.
reason: The banner has the letters IHC painted on it, which is text. Repaint the Five Wounds banner without lettering.
